landing.tagline: Every conversation leaves a trace. We read it.
landing.feature1desc: See how the tone shifted month by month.
landing.feature2desc: The gaps tell a story too.
landing.feature3desc: A written interpretation in plain language.
landing.privacyNote: We do not store your messages. The full report uses Google Gemini, which keeps the text for 55 days to detect abuse and does not use it for training.
landing.block1desc: See how the tone of a conversation shifted month by month. Warmth. Distance. Silence.
landing.block2desc: The gaps between messages tell a story too. LASTSEEN reads what wasn't said.
landing.block3desc: A written interpretation in plain language. Not a summary, but a story about two people.
landing.step1: Export your WhatsApp chat without media. Just the .txt file.
landing.step2: You upload it. Without an account you see a preview with counts and schedules. The full report uses one credit.
landing.step3: See the story. In chapters. Without the cold.
landing.seen1desc: Corrected initiative balance: not who messaged first, but who broke the silence when the other person wouldn't. Plus double text tracking: who followed up unanswered.
landing.seen2desc: Response decay over time. A score from 0 to 1. A turning point date. A trend.
landing.seen3desc: Each person's tone by quarter. Emotional drift between them. When they diverged.
landing.seen4desc: An AI-generated interpretation: overview, dynamic, turning point, current state, reflection. Written to feel, not to report.
landing.coming1desc: The exact moment a conversation stopped being mutual. Not a score, a date.
landing.coming2desc: Who holds the group together. Who went quiet first. The social map of a conversation.
landing.coming3desc: Parsers already built. Full pipeline support coming in v2.
landing.closing: Some conversations end before the last message.

legal.title: Privacy and terms
privacyItems: The chat file is processed and discarded. It is not stored.
For the full report, the message text is sent to Google Gemini. It is sent without sender names and with emails, links and long numbers (phones, ID numbers, accounts) replaced by placeholders.
Google keeps what is sent for 55 days to detect abusive use. Authorized Google staff may review it for that purpose. It does not use it to train or improve its models.
The free preview sends nothing to Google.
Names written inside a message are not redacted.
We store the account email, the report (metrics, participant names and narrative) and the payment record.
A result without an account is deleted after one hour.
You can delete the report from your account.
Payment is processed by Lemon Squeezy. We never see or store card data.
termsItems: The report is an automatic statistical reading of a chat. It is not a diagnosis or psychological or legal advice.
By uploading a chat you declare that you take part in that conversation.
One credit equals one full analysis and is spent when you upload the chat.
If the analysis fails, the credit is returned automatically.
